dialogue: All units move in. We have a narrow window.
Bandits at twelve o'clock! Engaging evasive maneuvers.
Radar contact confirmed. Three bogeys inbound.
Hold formation. Wait for my signal.
Signal interference detected. Switching to backup frequency.
All units, go loud! Weapons free!
Fox two! Fox two! Missile away!
Direct hit confirmed. Target is down.
Good work. All units rally at checkpoint Bravo.
Acknowledged. Heading to Bravo. Fuel is getting low.
Command, this is Overwatch. Mission success.
